workarounds.symptom: CRLF line endings can be corrupted by relaxed edit matching
workarounds.workaround: Fix: Preserve CRLF in edit approval previews. Target files: packages/agent/src/edit-content.ts, packages/agent/src/edit-resolve.ts, packages/agent/src/extensions/edit-tool.test.ts. Thanks @ROHITHELAYARAJA for reporting this. The fix covers single-line and multiline CRLF approval previews and keeps them consistent with file writes. (Ref: https://github.com/abacusai/abacusai-bot/pull/203)
